body:
## Summary

Pixel-matched implementation of the **workout-tracker.html** design from claude.ai/design. Makes the List tab the public landing page (renders for both auth and unauth visitors) and gives it an anatomical hero, scoreboard stats strip, filter pills, and a date-grouped timeline of workouts / cardio / soreness. Adds a 12-segment cycle dial to the sidebar showing today's day in its accent.

## Changes

- **New** `utils/dayDesign.js` — per-day accent hex, muscle slug, group label, helpers (`dayColor`, `dayMuscle`, `anatomyUrl`, `pad2`, `sorenessTierColor`)
- **New** `components/CycleDial.jsx` — 12-segment SVG dial with completed/current/future fills and "TODAY · D## · GROUP" center stack
- **Rewritten** `components/ListTab.jsx` — anatomical hero (eyebrow + streak, big `D##`, day name in accent, focus subtitle, description, log/exercises buttons, `mix-blend-mode: lighten` anatomy cutout), 4-up stats strip, filter pills with counts, date-grouped timeline with WorkoutCard (anatomy thumb + day chip + sparkline + expand), CardioCard (bike/run icon + metrics), SorenessCard (orange chip + level-tinted muscle pills). Streak / cycles computed from real fetched data via `useDataSource`.
- **Updated** `index.css` — Archivo via Google Fonts, design tokens (`--day-1..12`, `--muscle-red`, surfaces, ease/timing), and `.anatomy` / `.display` / `.eyebrow` / `.tnum` utility classes
- **Updated** `App.jsx` — `list` is the default tab (`/` maps to `list`, post-log success redirect goes to list, tab order puts List first), passes `currentDay` into ListTab, sidebar hosts `<CycleDial>` above the TabBar when expanded (admin click navigates day)

## Test plan

- [x] `npm run build` clean
- [x] `npm run dev` boots, ListTab compiles
- [ ] Visual check on `/` (anonymous): hero + stats + feed render against snapshot data
- [ ] Visual check on `/` (admin): cycle dial click changes the current day
- [ ] Click into a workout row to expand exercises; mode badges / shoulder-safe warning render
